response.text:
Below is a draft notice you can use. I will not send it. Do you want me to save this to your Gmail drafts now? If so, confirm the recipient list and subject line (and whether to CC legal). I can put Legal on CC if you want.

Draft subject suggestion: Important: Seattle team reduction (effective Oct 31)

Draft body:
Team —

I need to share an important staffing update for the Seattle organization. On Oct 31, we will be reducing roles on the Seattle team. This reduction will affect 14 roles.

Managers will begin one-on-one conversations starting tomorrow morning to notify impacted individuals and answer immediate questions. Severance and other HR details are being finalized and HR will provide the full severance information on Monday. Please do not share speculative details until we have the official HR guidance.

Legal review is required before this message is sent. Do not distribute this notice externally or to the team until Legal has reviewed and we have confirmation to proceed.

If you have immediate questions, please reach out to HR or to me directly.

Thank you for your understanding and for handling this with care.

[Your name / Title]

Notes:
- This draft omits named severance details because HR will provide them on Monday.
- Let me know if you want the message tailored differently (tone, level of detail, adding manager names, including Legal or HR contacts, or addressing only impacted employees vs. the whole Seattle team).
